title: Sources
description: Only selected sources are used in the chat and in the Studio.

empty.title: Add your first source
empty.body: Upload a document, spreadsheet, PDF or text file, add a web page or a YouTube video, or paste text.

delete.title: Delete “{{title}}”?
delete.body: It will be removed from this notebook. Chats and outputs made from it are kept.

addDialog.title: Add sources
addDialog.description: Sources stay in this browser. Their text is sent to your model when you ask questions or create something.
addDialog.fileTypes: Documents, spreadsheets, slides, PDFs, EPUBs, Markdown, CSV and other text files, up to 20 MB each.
addDialog.urlHint: The page's main text is saved as a source.
addDialog.textPlaceholder: Paste notes, an article or a transcript
addDialog.youtubeHint: The video's transcript is saved as a source. It needs to be public and have captions.

errors.empty: No text could be read from {{name}}.
errors.type: {{name}} is not a supported file type.
errors.url: Enter a full address starting with http:// or https://.
errors.noCaptions: {{name}} has no captions, so there is no transcript to add.
errors.private: {{name}} is private or restricted. Only public videos can be added.
